    public String ak375(int n, String str) {
        Pattern insidePattern = Pattern.compile("\\(([^)]*)\\)");
        Matcher matcher = insidePattern.matcher(str);
        
        int res2 = 0;
        StringBuilder outside = new StringBuilder();
        int lastEnd = 0;
        
        while (matcher.find()) {
            res2++;
            outside.append("_");
            if (matcher.start() > lastEnd) {
                outside.append(str.substring(lastEnd, matcher.start()));
            }
            lastEnd = matcher.end();
        }
        if (lastEnd < n) {
            outside.append(str.substring(lastEnd));

        String[] parts = outside.toString().split("_");
